chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Bujayl, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl al-Daqqāq, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn al-Thaqafī, from ʿAlī ibn Bujayl ibn ʿAqīl al-Kūfī.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْ: A transmitter identified by kunyah, name, and tribal affiliation.
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُتَّيْلِ الدَّقَّاقِ: A named transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating direct attribution of transmission by the compiler.
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ بُجَيْلِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ الْكُ: The final named transmitter to whom this chain leads.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي ال: A transmitter in the chain of narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Bujayl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Bujayl. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and identifying the authorities linking the compiler to the named narrator.
